title: Doc comments on #[cfg(test)] private helpers are misleading
description: In crates/transit/src/peering/pipeline.rs, the functions parse_newsgroups (line 547) and extract_message_id (line 561) are decorated with #[cfg(test)] and are therefore test-only helpers. However, both have triple-slash doc comments placed after the #[cfg(test)] attribute. The convention for #[cfg(test)] helpers is to use plain double-slash comments rather than doc comments, since these functions are not part of the public or private API — they are scaffolding. A reader scanning the file will see the doc-comment markers and assume these are intended as documented API entry points, then be puzzled that they are gated on cfg(test). The comments should be changed from doc-comments to plain comments to match the test-helper convention.
